All KimiIta content is currently untranslated.

Kimi ga Ita Kisetsu ~Primary~ is the original 1999 game.
Kimi ga Ita Kisetsu - First Press Limited Edition is the 2011 remake. This release was accompanied by DLC.
Feel free to visit [the wiki page](https://muvluv.fandom.com/wiki/Kimi_ga_Ita_Kisetsu) for more info!

However, as events begin to happen around him, he's presented with a choice, to go study photography under Helmut Newton-John himself, or to perhaps give up on his dream, and pursue love instead."
